standard_prerequisites.name: Separated target makes quasi-finite morphisms affine
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, Lemma morphisms-lemma-affine-permanence, cited at proof lines 23092-23093
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that X -> Y is affine once Y is separated, the standing input for every 'affine over X is affine' step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Maximum of the weighted integral and finiteness over its stratum
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemmas lemma-max-int-w (line 23095) and lemma-max-int-finite (lines 23098-23099) of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the induction parameter d and that f^{-1}(Y_d) -> Y_d is finite.

standard_prerequisites.name: Affineness of the maximum stratum
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma lemma-affineness-of-large-open of this chapter, cited at proof lines 23099-23102
standard_prerequisites.use: Y_d meets every affine open W of Y affinely, hence Y_d -> Y is an affine morphism of schemes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Affineness from an affine surjective cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits, Lemma limits-lemma-affine, cited at proof lines 23108-23109
standard_prerequisites.use: Y_d is affine because it is surjected upon by the affine scheme f^{-1}(Y_d).

standard_prerequisites.name: Weightings are stable under base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma lemma-weighting-base-change of this chapter, cited at proof lines 23119-23121
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the induction start again on the reduced closed part Y' with the restricted weighting w'.

core_obligations: 主义务是把 'asn(Y) <= #{distinct values of int_f w} - 1' 做成对最大积分值 d 的归纳：每一层 Y_d 的仿射性要靠三段传递链——lemma-affineness-of-large-open 给 Y_d 与任意仿射开之交仿射（用到 W x_Y X affine over X），故 Y_d -> Y 是仿射态射；f^{-1}(Y_d) 仿射 over X 故仿射；满射 + 仿射覆盖（limits-lemma-affine）得 Y_d 仿射。
归纳步的结构义务：Y' = Y 减去 Y_d 视为 reduced 闭子概形，X' = Y' x_Y X 闭于 X 故仿射；w 经 lemma-weighting-base-change 诱导 f' 的 weighting w'，且 int_{f'} w' 是 int_f w 在 Y' 上的限制——这保证 distinct values 的个数严格减少，归纳假设适用。
拼接义务：Y 的仿射分层由 Y_d 及归纳给出的 Y' 的分层拼成，长度与 distinct values 个数减 1 对齐；脚注里 'diagonal affine 即可' 的弱化条件只在 morphisms-lemma-affine-permanence 的前提处起作用，已在标准前提里说明。
proof_roadmap: 开局：Y separated ⇒ f affine（morphisms-lemma-affine-permanence）；int_f w 的最大值 d 存在（lemma-max-int-w），并对 d 归纳。

取最大值层 Y_d = {int_f w = d}：由 lemma-max-int-finite 得 f^{-1}(Y_d) -> Y_d 有限；由 lemma-affineness-of-large-open 得 Y_d 与任意仿射开交仿射 ⇒ Y_d -> Y 仿射；于是 f^{-1}(Y_d) = Y_d x_Y X 仿射 over X 故仿射，满射回 Y_d 配 limits-lemma-affine 得 Y_d 仿射。
若 Y_d = Y 则 asn = 0 直接收尾；否则取 Y' = Y 减 Y_d（reduced 闭），X' = Y' x_Y X（闭于仿射 X 故仿射），f' = X' -> Y' 满射，w' 由 lemma-weighting-base-change 诱导且积分函数限制到 Y'；对 Y' 用归纳假设得分层，与 Y_d 拼接完成证明。
difficulty_reason: 归纳骨架清晰但每一层的仿射性都要走一条四环传递链（交仿射 ⇒ 态射仿射 ⇒ 原像仿射 over X ⇒ 满射 + 仿射覆盖 ⇒ 目标仿射），方向与判据容易用反；归纳步还要同时核对 weighting 的基变换稳定性与积分函数的限制关系，漏一条则 distinct values 递减不成立。
